observations: Both official GCIS manuals have matching information-security section 12.5. The isiXhosa term appears between network/firewall protection and logical access control; English places encryption at the corresponding position.

Direct PDF rendering confirms the term is printed in the security context, rather than an unrelated translation or a misleading search snippet. The page is physically 17, zero-based 16, and printed 16.

This establishes a documented technical use of uguqulelo oluntsonkothileyo for encryption and resolves the exact ambiguity that prevented the initial acceptance. It does not certify every translation in either manual.
